subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding asset allocation: how a portfolio's mix of stocks, bonds, and cash might shift based on age and goals
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student adjusts a simulated portfolio's stock/bond mix for a younger investor versus someone near retirement
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an investor's age/goal to a reasonable portfolio mix
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a younger investor's portfolio might reasonably differ from an older investor's

misconception_flags: assumes portfolio allocation should be identical regardless of an investor's age or time horizon

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
